source.citation: Li X, Zhao H, Cui Y. Efficacy and safety of atezolizumab compared to docetaxel in non-small cell lung cancer patients regardless of PD-L1 status: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Chin Clin Oncol. 2025;14(5):51.
source.notes: 10 double-blind RCTs; atezolizumab (n=3445) vs docetaxel (n=3018); any PD-L1 expression; any histology; NSCLC.

caveats: DRAFT ANSWER KEY: published values from Li 2025 abstract (PMID 41208418, DOI 10.21037/cco-25-45); human verification required before sealing.
I2 values not reported in abstract; i2 set to null.
Engine PubMed-only recall found k=4 studies vs published k=10 (engine search lacked EMBASE/CNKI/WOS/Wanfang/Cochrane used by Li 2025); OS HR directionally concordant.
pfs_hr: engine extracted only 1 parseable PFS HR (PMID 38552197/CONTACT-01), insufficient for pooling; expected missing_engine classification.
Benchmark scores are scaffold-only; do not report as sealed performance.
